Common requirements passing is not whole-delivery acceptance.
Stage observations are dependent work, not replications.
One ordered pair of coupled feature development, not weeks-scale large-project evidence.
Counts describe coverage, not an overall quality score.
No same-budget successful-completion speed ratio: control exceeded observed output cap.
Monetary cost and human review time are unknown.
Raw command stdout is not retained by campaign; command completion/exit events and saved handoffs are retained.
